title: The Specific question about the plan
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：specific　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 specific 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the engineer wrote of ① a specific question about the plan in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so specific that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the specific ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the specific question about the plan that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too specific to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the specific ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a specific reason for the delay, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as specific as the reason for the delay they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was specific or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something specific, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite specific; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the specific ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, without complaint, she wrote of another specific question about the plan in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less specific than anybody had expected. ⑩ The specific reason for the delay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the specific ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 具体（前置定语 a specific question about the plan：1964 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件具体的问题）
B. adj. 具体／特定（两处加强说法：so specific that … 与 no less specific than …）
C. adj. 具体／特定（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 具体（表语 too specific to do：母亲觉得它太具体，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 特定（前置定语 a specific reason for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩特定的具体原因）
F. adj. 特定（同级比较 as specific as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩拖延的具体原因相比）
G. adj. 特定（后置定语 something specific：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 特定（受程度副词修饰 quite specific：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a specific question about the plan
the specific question about the plan that
a specific reason for the delay
The specific reason for the delay that

answers.why: specific 意为“具体”，1964 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件具体的问题”，此处作前置定语 a specific question about the plan。
specific 意为“具体”，此处用 so specific that 结构，说它具体到车间里没人敢靠近。
specific 意为“具体”，说明书上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的具体关于方案的具体问题，等于最高级的说法。
specific 意为“具体”，母亲认为这件东西“太具体了，谁也用不上”，too specific to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
specific 意为“特定”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩特定的具体原因”，此处作前置定语 a specific reason for the delay。
specific 意为“特定”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩拖延的具体原因一样特定”，同级比较用 as specific as。
specific 意为“特定”，说明书上那半行字要的是“特定的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something specific。
specific 意为“特定”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当特定”，quite 修饰原级 specific。
specific 意为“特定”，no less specific than 表示“其特定不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之特定不亚于任何人的预料。
specific 意为“特定”，母亲 1976 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的特定具体原因”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件具体的问题。（a specific question about the plan）
它具体到车间里没有一个人敢靠近。（so specific that …）
母亲觉得它太具体，谁也用不上。（too specific to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩特定的具体原因。（a specific reason for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩拖延的具体原因一样特定。（as specific as …）
到了 1971 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件特定的东西。（something specific）
answers: In 1964 the engineer wrote of a specific question about the plan in the manual.
It was so specific that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too specific to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a specific reason for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as specific as the reason for the delay they had once had.
By 1971 the manual asked for nothing but something specific.

answers: In 1964 the engineer wrote of a specific question about the plan in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
